previousEntry.prompt: Create ONE original production isometric pixel-art game sprite, a dense green hedge wall for a fantasy tabletop. The supplied original hedge is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE: preserve its rich layered leaves, small angular leaf clusters, highlights and deep shadow pockets, but intentionally redesign its form into a convincing substantial hedge segment with visible top and two camera-facing sides. Orthographic 2:1 isometric projection (ground edges slope exactly 1 vertical to 2 horizontal), viewed from above. A single square-cell hedge mass, not a long thin wall. Ground contact sits on a 2:1 diamond footprint, no thick soil pedestal or surrounding scene. Raised silhouette slightly irregular foliage, professionally composed pixel clusters and readable volume, not a geometrical cube painted flat, not noise. Sunny yellow-green upper left highlights, emerald middle tones, deep green right side. Height roughly 1.2 times its ground diamond height; broad and substantial, not tall column. Transparent background, one isolated sprite centered with ample clear margins, no text, no drop shadow, no grid, no floor tile, no neighboring objects. Crisp chunky pixel art, no blur, no painterly rendering, no glossy 3D. Maintain same fixed isometric camera as reference.

attempts.prompt: Use case: original production pixel-art terrain sprite. Material ID wall-hedge-dense, role FULL-BLOCK CONNECTED WALL, not a freestanding shrub. Image 1 is the EXACT GEOMETRY REGISTRATION GUIDE. Image 2 shows actual project-owned stone wall (left, geometry reference only) and foliage (right, leaf detail/palette reference only). Create ONE original beautiful detailed dense green hedge wall tile. Follow image 1's structural geometry precisely, replacing ALL guide colours/lines/dots with authored foliage artwork, no guide visible. Preserve the 960x1200 transparent canvas and guide placement: top cap diamond rear(480,192), right(864,384), front(480,576), left(96,384). Base contacts left(96,864), front(480,1056), right(864,864); hidden rear base(480,672). All edge slopes exactly 1 vertical:2 horizontal. Top is a broad DIAMOND plane, not a thin slanted ridge. Left and right visible faces must connect their respective top and base edges; upright sides don't taper or lean. The lower front corner is directly below the top front corner. This structural form must join exact copies shifted (+384,+192) or (-384,+192), producing continuous leafy walls AND a filled 3x3 cluster without gaps or sawtooth protruding rectangles. It must occupy both axis interfaces equally, not be only 3/4-width. Treat these contacts as a clipped/trained thick hedge's continuous living volume. Make its ART rich: layered clusters of individually readable angular leaves, warm yellow-green highlights on the upper-left cap, emerald and olive middle tones, dark interior branches and shaded recesses, darker right face. Crafted chunky pixel clusters readable when uniformly reduced to 128px ground width. Organic leaf detail and subtle top variation are welcome but must NOT shrink the connection faces, expose empty holes, taper the base, move ground contacts or break the diamond top. No pedestal, soil border, shadow, neighboring props, background, labels, text, grid or guides. No flat green silhouette, no primitive polygon-colour replacement, no noise-only texture, no painting a blurry texture onto a box, no glossy 3D. One single fully authored crisp pixel-art hedge tile with genuinely constructed foliage volume. Keep exact guide perspective and framing.
